slide_text: Finding Square Roots You're going to find the square root of any number without using any built-in function. All you need is multiplication, a bit of guessing, and a clever trick that cuts your search in half every time. Along the way, you'll pick up Python basics: expressions, variables, if-else, loops, and functions all by solving one real problem. Navigate: press or Space to advance | to go back

slide_text: Every guess eliminates half of the remaining range. After 1 guess: half the range left After 5 guesses: 1/32 of the range After 10 guesses: 1/1024 of the range After 20 guesses: 1/1,048,576 of the range

fragments.text: This halving strategy is called binary search binary because you split the range in two each time. It is one of the most important algorithms in computer science and you just invented it.
